_comment: Independently authored SYNTHETIC samples modeled on observed Wiki structure. Not source evidence. Run scripts/wiki_corpus_extract.py --synthetic to regenerate synthetic_manifest.json (field expectations come from the frozen policy, not the parser).

samples.modeled_on: WikiWikiJP page labels (NM/BFNM/mission lists) rendered as MediaWiki template parameters
samples.excerpt_wikitext:
{{NM情報
|ノートリアスモンスター=[[テスト用NM]]
|出現条件=テスト用アイテムをトレード
|ポップ条件=夜間のみ
|戦利品=[[テスト用の指輪]]
|報酬=経験値
|必要条件=ミッション進行
|ミッション=テスト用ミッション
|エリア=テスト用エリア
|備考=これは説明文です
}}
samples.note: Original Japanese labels and values must survive verbatim

samples.modeled_on: Japanese value with wiki link and display label
samples.note: source_links must keep target and markup in original language

samples.modeled_on: free-prose spawn/notes fields and ambiguous link targets
samples.note: Links remain review-only; ambiguous titles never resolve automatically
Exact-label policy ignores case and surrounding whitespace only

samples.modeled_on: near-miss labels seen on real pages (DropsB, Zone Name, ...)
samples.excerpt_wikitext:
{{NM
|DropsB=[[Test Ring]]
|Drops:=[[Test Ring]]
|Drop Rate=10%
|Zone Name=Test Zone
|Quest Name=Test Quest
|Location (JP)=テスト
|Rewards List=Test
}}
samples.note: None of these are exact allowlist labels; all must be rejected

samples.modeled_on: Medusa/Absolute Virtue: Notes parameter that embeds ===heading=== lines
samples.excerpt_wikitext:
{{Adversary Description
|Class=NM
|Notes=
===Getting There===
Located behind a door.
|Location=Test Zone
}}
samples.note: Template parameter text is also scanned for headings by the line parser; fields must still be extracted

samples.modeled_on: Reward values containing nested templates and links
samples.note: Raw value is preserved including nested template markup
No candidate from empty values; positional params have no label
Unclosed template; behavior pinned, must not raise
Row-oriented table: only the exact first-column label rows are candidates
